text:
anya: Hey team — opened a small PR for a compact metering + dashboard snippet that lives in the rate/quotas doc. Need quick QA and billing signoff. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :sparkles:

anya: TL;DR: provide a concise SDK example showing how to compute metered tokens, surface estimated cost, and link to the dashboard panel for per-route usage. Also added a note for migration from old tier mapping. Copy pasted snippet below for quick review.

anya: ```js
// minimal: compute tokens + estimated cost
const usage = await client.usage.getLatest({ model: 'redwood-3b' });
const tokens = usage.totalTokens;
const estimated_cost = tokens * pricing.perToken; // approximate
console.log({ tokens, estimated_cost });
```

jake: quick glance — actionable items: change endpoint in example to `/v1/usage` (not `/v1/metrics`), and include example branch for `burst_credits` disabled. also spacing in the code block is a tiny lint nit.

maria: billing QA: overall approach ok. please don't hardcode absolute token budgets in the snippet. our canonical limits are: free=100k tokens/mo, pro=1M tokens/mo, enterprise=custom. better to reference `{tier_limits}` placeholder and point to the pricing page. also confirm which unit pricing variable you use.

sam: product note — rename `cost` -> `estimated_cost` (to signal approximation) and add a 1-line caveat: "estimates exclude third-party infra additions and rounding."

docbot: docs-ci: build passed for PR 1234 — https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/1234 (html preview generation ok)

anya: thanks — will update. I pushed a new commit that: uses `/v1/usage`, replaces numbers with `{tier_limits}`, renames var to `estimated_cost`, and added the caveat. also added dashboard panel id `panel-usage-2` under the "Per-route usage" section — pinging grafana owners to confirm panel id.

jake: confirmed `panel-usage-2` exists in prod grafana and points at the per-route token timeseries. also added a tiny spacing fix in code block, pushed suggestion.

maria: ack on panel. one more ask: add a single sentence about the grace period behavior when tier quotas are exceeded (how burst credits and overage are treated). helps support + sales.

anya: done — added: "If a request exceeds quota, burst credits are consumed first; overage is billed per-token thereafter (see pricing page)."

leo: (eng-ml) quick technical check: KV cache does not affect billing totals — we measure tokens at request ingress before cache/beam/allocation, so the snippet's accounting approach is valid.

sam: LGTM from product. plan: merge tomorrow 10:00 PT if no objections. @jake can you merge once CI is green?

jake: will give a final pass and merge after CI. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
